CustomField.label: Veleiro Project Id
CustomField.description: Optional Veleiro project (project_id) that tickets are filed under. If blank, tasks are created at the client level with no project. Set in the Ticket Intake Setup panel.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. The Veleiro project this org's tickets belong to. Leave blank to file tickets at the client level. Pick it in the Ticket Intake Setup panel.
